basic_details.scholarship_name: American University of Sharjah (AUS) Chancellor's & Graduate Assistantship
basic_details.offering_entity: American University of Sharjah (AUS) Office of Graduate Studies
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: American University of Sharjah (University City, Sharjah, UAE)
basic_details.major_restrictions: College of Engineering (Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechatronics, Biomedical Engineering, Engineering Systems Management), College of Arts and Sciences, and School of Business Administration.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~80 to 120 graduate assistantships and scholarships awarded annually across Master's and PhD programs
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open international competition; Pakistani engineering and computing graduates secure ~12 to 20 awards annually
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Up to 2 years for Master's; up to 4 years for PhD, renewed each semester based on maintaining a minimum CGPA of 3.50 / 4.00

nationality_requirements: Open to outstanding applicants of all nationalities globally (Pakistan eligible)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No formal age limit; evaluated on academic merit, technical aptitude, and research capacity.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Recognized 4-year Bachelor's degree (16 years education) for Master's; recognized Master's degree (18 years education) for PhD from an HEC-recognized university in a relevant engineering or science discipline with high academic standing (minimum CGPA 3.50 / 4.00; competitive admits typically 3.70+ / 4.00).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum undergraduate CGPA of 3.50 / 4.00 for full assistantship/scholarship consideration.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Relevant undergraduate degree in engineering, computer science, mathematics, or physical sciences.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduating seniors in their final semester can apply conditionally with certified interim transcripts.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Prior research laboratory experience, programming proficiency, or published papers significantly increase funding priority.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic minimum 6.5 or TOEFL iBT minimum 80 (or EmSAT English 1550+). Official test score report is mandatory.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None; instruction and research conducted entirely in English.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Applicants apply for Graduate Assistantships (GTA/GRA) directly during the AUS online application process.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold concurrent awards or employment outside AUS.

tuition_fee.details: Full 100% tuition fee waiver for full Graduate Teaching/Research Assistantship recipients (~AED 80,000 to 120,000 total degree value).

admission_application_fee.details: AUS graduate application fee of AED 450 (~USD 122; ~PKR 34,200) paid online via credit card.

accommodation.details: Free on-campus student residential housing in AUS graduate dormitories in University City Sharjah, or subsidized housing allowance.

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly tax-free living stipend: AED 4,000 to AED 6,500 / month (~USD 1,090 to 1,770 / month; ~PKR 304,000 to 494,000 / month) for full assistantship recipients (Master's: AED 4,000 to 5,000; PhD: AED 6,000 to 6,500).

airfare.details: Initial relocation flight assistance or annual travel allowance provided under specific college assistantship packages.

visa_fee.details: UAE Student Residence Visa sponsorship, medical examination, and Emirates ID fees sponsored and handled by AUS.

health_insurance.details: Comprehensive health insurance policy covering outpatient, inpatient, and emergency medical care across the UAE.

food_allowance.details: Diverse campus dining facilities in the Student Center; living costs easily managed within the monthly stipend.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Comprehensive access to AUS Library, IEEE Xplore, ScienceDirect, computational facilities, and engineering laboratories.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Funding available for presenting peer-reviewed papers at leading international conferences and laboratory project supplies.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Free campus shuttle buses connecting residential dormitories, academic buildings, and Sharjah/Dubai metro links.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single host university (American University of Sharjah)
participating_institutions: American University of Sharjah (AUS) - University City (Sharjah, UAE)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: QS World University Rankings #332 worldwide, Times Higher Education #351-400, accredited in the USA by MSCHE and in the UAE by CAA.
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Online AUS application, official Bachelor's transcripts and degree certificates with minimum CGPA 3.50/4.00, official IELTS/TOEFL score report, two letters of recommendation, CV, statement of purpose, and GRE score (recommended for engineering).
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Computer Engineering and Engineering Systems Management receive high volumes of competitive applications; having GRE scores (Quant 155+) and an aligned faculty interest strengthens the assistantship application.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Review AUS College of Engineering faculty research profiles and email potential advisors with your CV and a summary of your thesis/research interests before submitting.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register an account on apply.aus.edu, select the graduate degree program, check the box for Graduate Assistantship (GTA/GRA), and upload all academic documents.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Check application deadlines on apply.aus.edu (Priority Fall deadline: March 15 / Final: June 15).
Step 2: Take IELTS (min 6.5) or TOEFL (min 80) and request official score submission.
Step 3: Create account on the AUS application portal, complete personal details, and upload degree certificates and transcripts.
Step 4: Indicate application for Graduate Assistantship (Teaching or Research).
Step 5: Pay the application fee of AED 450 online via credit card.
Step 6: Nominate two academic referees who will submit letters via automated email links.
Step 7: Departmental Graduate Committee reviews applications and conducts video interviews (April - May).
Step 8: Final admission and assistantship offer letters dispatched (May - June).
Step 9: Complete UAE visa processing, accept assistantship contract, and arrive in Sharjah in August.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated Track: Assistantship application is embedded directly within the online graduate admission form.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by referees via secure automated links generated by the AUS admissions system.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of purpose outlining academic background, technical skills, career aspirations, and motivations for graduate study at AUS.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: For PhD applicants: 3 to 5-page research proposal detailing proposed topic, literature review, and methodology.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Academic CV detailing educational trajectory, technical proficiencies, research publications, and software tools.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: 20 to 30-minute online interview conducted by departmental faculty evaluating technical competence, research potential, and English communication.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic (min 6.5) or TOEFL iBT (min 80) mandatory; GRE strongly recommended for engineering applicants.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Bachelor's degree and transcripts must be attested by HEC Pakistan, MoFA, and the UAE Embassy in Islamabad upon final admission.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translation required for any documents not in English.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Complete transcripts and degrees with minimum CGPA 3.50/4.00.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Attested by HEC Pakistan with grading scale explanation.
Must be valid within 2 years of application date.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Submitted directly by former university professors assessing academic competence.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Must be sent from official institutional email addresses.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Detailed essay outlining academic background and graduate study motivations.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Articulate clear alignment with AUS engineering faculty labs.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Academic CV detailing research projects, papers, and technical skillsets.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Highlight any published work or major final-year projects.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Clear color copy of passport identification page valid for at least 2 years.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Pakistani passport must have validity through late 2028.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Main intake is Fall semester (August start). Priority applications submitted by March 15 receive premier assistantship consideration.

selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: AUS Departmental Graduate Committee, College Graduate Programs Board, and Office of Graduate Studies.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Two-phase evaluation: academic dossier review followed by faculty interview and assistantship allocation.

competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~6.0% among competitive STEM applicants with CGPA 3.60+
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: CGPA 3.60+ / 4.00 from top Pakistani engineering institutions (NUST, GIKI, FAST, UET, PIEAS)
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: High academic grades, strong programming and analytical skills, and tangible research or engineering project outcomes.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates of Pakistani top engineering and computer science universities.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: UAE, Pakistan, Jordan, Egypt, India, Lebanon, Syria, Iran, Palestine.

fake_websites_and_scams: Beware of unauthorized agents claiming to sell admission or assistantships to AUS.
Applications are handled exclusively via aus.edu and apply.aus.edu.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: AUS charges an official AED 450 application fee paid directly via the application portal; never pay agents.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: AUS does not authorize commercial recruitment agencies for graduate assistantship allocation.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Degree attestation in Pakistan (HEC and MoFA) and UAE Embassy legalization: ~PKR 35,000 to 45,000.
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: Assistantships only cover 50% tuition. Reality: Full Graduate Teaching/Research Assistantships provide 100% tuition waiver plus monthly stipends and housing.
Myth: You can hold an external job while on an assistantship. Reality: Assistantship recipients are expected to commit full-time to their studies and departmental duties.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial blogs suggest GRE is mandatory; GRE is strongly recommended but not strictly mandatory for all disciplines.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.50 / 4.00 each semester; dropping below 3.50 results in loss of assistantship.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time on-campus commitment and fulfilling up to 20 hours per week of assigned teaching or research assistantship duties.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Semester-end academic and duty performance review by the Department Head and supervisory faculty.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Scholars may not hold concurrent external employment during the assistantship period.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: No mandatory return requirement; graduates can transition to professional industry careers in the UAE or pursue PhD studies globally.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Zero service bond or repayment obligation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Assistantship revoked if student withdraws without justification or is dismissed for disciplinary infractions.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Major change requires formal review and typically results in loss of assistantship funding.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Assistantship duration is strictly limited to 2 years for Master's and 4 years for PhD; extensions are subject to external faculty research funding.
